evidence.description: 2-4 short verbatim quotes from the speech that show the speaker's view on policy; empty if not relevant.
evidence.title: Evidence

level.description: 0-10 on the absolute scale, chosen from the quotes and summary above; null if policy_relevant is false.
level.title: Level

policy_relevant.description: True if the speech reveals the speaker's own view on the stance of U.S. monetary policy.
policy_relevant.title: Policy Relevant

rationale.description: One or two sentences in English, written as a summary for readers: what the speaker says about where policy should go and why. Do not mention levels, numbers on the scale or these instructions. If not relevant, what the speech is about.
rationale.title: Rationale
